metadata.scenario_context: Adam has won a scholarship to study at a prestigious university. His friends plan to hold a celebration party in his honor.

shared_prefix.speaker: Omar
shared_prefix.message: I'm not sure about champagne, Kelly. In my family, we usually give thoughtful gifts that show we care. How about a personalized photo album or something that shows how proud we are of him? My parents always taught me that a gift should come from the heart.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kelly
shared_prefix.message: That's a sweet idea, but I'm not sure about the whole "proud" thing. I mean, I'm happy for Adam and all, but I don't really think about making my parents proud as a goal or anything. Anyway, back to the gift... champagne is classic, don't you think? It's for celebrations.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Omar
shared_prefix.message: But making my parents proud is a big deal for me, it's always been a main goal in my life. I think a gift that shows we're proud of Adam would mean a lot to him. Champagne is nice, but it's just something you drink and then it's gone. A personalized gift would last longer and show we really care.

shared_prefix.speaker: Kelly
shared_prefix.message: I understand where you're coming from, and I think that's really sweet of you to want to make your parents proud. But, deep down, we are all the same, and people are pretty much motivated by the same things - we all want to be happy and celebrated. When you really get to know people, they're pretty much like us, and I think we both know, at the end of the day, that it's the thought that counts, not whether we're trying to make our parents proud or not. Some values are just universal, like being kind and showing appreciation, and I think that's what we should focus on. It's a small world after all, and I'm sure Adam will appreciate whatever gift we get him, as long as it comes from the heart.
